title: Probe harness judges photo side edits and drop targets from probe-reported block ranges, in Dart
context: PR #188 review: GR2 allowed the whole document for photo commands, and GR6 and GR7 aimed drags and drops with layout coordinates. The zsh driver cannot parse Markdown blocks reliably.
options: have the probe report block start, end, unclosedFence and global top and bottom, and judge P3 ranges in gates.dart with the tested oracle
outcome: The probe's /state blocks now carry start, end, unclosedFence, globalTop and globalBottom. The driver sends a photoCommand (control, photo ordinal, source, blocks) and gates.dart derives the allowed ranges with oracles.photoCommandRanges. Drops and drags aim at the probe-reported window coordinates of the intended boundary. This reuses the tested Dart oracle instead of reimplementing P3 in shell. Commits 7f9a164 and 90f3124 on mitosis/harness.
